MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug gives my existing Echo devices a useful new purpose: controlling a lamp without buying another speaker.",
    "The larger external drive fits a possible next step beyond my older 4TB backup drive, and the recovery service matches my past interest in protecting stored data.",
    "Computer cleaning supplies fit my repeated use of keyboards and mice, while outdoor cameras could extend my basic home security setup; both are relevant, although the quantity and coverage need more thought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV Stick, an older Echo Dot, and another Echo display duplicate needs covered by my recent purchases rather than adding something useful.",
    "Using Alexa at home does not mean I want it in my car; I have no current reason to add Echo Auto.",
    "The charging cables assume both a replacement need and device compatibility that my history does not establish, while eight cans of duster exceed what I would choose now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Echo purchases seem to be treated as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it repeats a function I already have.",
    "My history of buying computer accessories seems to imply that I need more accessories now, regardless of their specific purpose or compatibility."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max, fourth-generation Echo Dot, and Echo Show 5 with its stand suggest those needs have already been addressed.",
    "An accessory that extends something I own is more appealing than another device that does the same job.",
    "Relevance does not always mean I am ready to buy: I would need to establish outdoor camera locations, confirm cable compatibility, or choose a smaller quantity of cleaning supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in home electronics but miss the difference between extending my setup and duplicating needs I recently filled."
}
